[[File:DetentionBlockAA23.png|thumb|250px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] are trapped in Detention Block AA 23's cell bay.]]
A '''detention area''', or '''security area''', was a location where prisoners were kept. The level of security in detention areas varied depending on their status; the lockups in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] featured metal bars and [[mechanical lock]]s, while the detention areas aboard the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] featured sophisticated security systems including [[automated laser trap]]s and [[Security scanner/Legends|security scanners]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The detention area of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] was a lower bubble.

The detention area of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] was the location of [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]].

The detention area of [[Crimson Jack's battlecruiser]] was the [[retention block]].
